hub.title: Settings
hub.demoDesc: The demo is pre-loaded with a demo account — sign-in and account switching work in the installed app.

renewQr.scan: Scan with your phone to renew — <1>{{username}}</1>

expiry.bodyExpired: Reach out to Snow Media to renew and restore access. You can renew through the store or by contacting support.
expiry.bodySoon: Reach out to Snow Media to renew and avoid losing access. You can renew through the store or by contacting support.

account.title: Account
account.noAccount: No player account on this device.

playerCard.title: Player Account
playerCard.subtitle: Signed in to your IPTV panel — used by the Player section.
playerCard.signedOutDesc: You can sign back in from the Player.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.tryHint: Pick another to try it on the Live TV screen.
appearance.viewSizeHint: For the Guide and the logo wall. Compact fits more channels on the screen; Large is easier to read.

backups.title: Backups
backups.subtitle: Streams posted by Snow Media. Press Refresh if something was just added.
backups.empty: No backups right now. When Snow Media posts one it shows up here automatically.
backups.streamError: Stream error — OK to retry, Back to stop.
backups.playFailedDesc: This backup stream could not be played.

hideCategories.title: Hide Categories
hideCategories.intro: Press OK on a category to hide it from the Player. Hidden categories stay on your service; they just stop taking up room here. Press OK again to bring one back.
hideCategories.signInFirst: Sign in to the Player first.
hideCategories.showAll: Show every category on this line

switch.title: Switch Account
switch.none: No saved accounts yet. Add one below.
switch.failedDesc: Sign-in failed. The saved password may be out of date.

credentials.title: Sign in to Player
credentials.subtitle: Use your subscription username & password
credentials.note: Email usernames connect to Vibez; all other usernames connect to DreamStreams. Your credentials are stored only on this device.
credentials.missingDesc: Please enter your username and password.
credentials.loadedDescEmail: Also signed into your Snow Media account ({{email}}).
credentials.loadedDesc: Also signed into your Snow Media account.
credentials.connectFailedDesc: Please check your credentials and try again.

claim.title: Finish your Snow Media account
claim.promptBody: Your Live TV login <1>{{username}}</1> is your Snow Media login. Add your name and an email or phone, and your account is set up for you: renewal reminders, My Account, support and the store, with no second password.
claim.qrAlt: QR code to claim your account on your phone
claim.qrBody: Scan with your phone to claim <1>{{username}}</1> — this screen updates itself when you finish.
claim.qrExpired: That QR code expired. Make a new one to keep going.
claim.qrError: Couldn't reach the server. Make a new one to keep going.
claim.manualBody: For <1>{{username}}</1>. Email or phone, at least one. Press Next on the keyboard to move down.
claim.errBadEmail: That email doesn't look right — check it and try again.
claim.errNeedContact: Add an email or a phone number so we can reach you.
claim.errEmailInUse: That email already has a Snow Media account. Sign into it once from My Account, or use a different email here.
claim.errVerify: We couldn't verify this box's Live TV sign-in right now — please try again in a minute.
claim.errRateLimited: Too many attempts — please wait a few minutes and try again.
claim.errGeneric: Something went wrong — please try the QR option.
claim.errNetwork: Connection problem — check your network and try again.

email.not_deployed: Email is not switched on for this server yet. Your details are still on screen.
email.auth_required: Email is not configured correctly on the server. Your details are still on screen.
email.invalid_email: That email address does not look right.
email.missing_credentials: This service has no login details yet.
email.invalid_credentials: The panel did not recognise this login, so nothing was sent.
email.panel_unreachable: Could not reach the streaming server just now. Your details are still on screen.
email.rate_limited: That has been sent a few times already. Try again in a few minutes.
email.email_unavailable: Email is not switched on for this server yet.
email.send_failed: The email could not be sent. Your details are still on screen.
